keyword: split piston and integral piston outer diameter

title.en: Which piston outer diameters appear on both Pinjin pages?
title.zh: 哪些活塞外径在品锦两页都出现？

description.en: Split and integral piston pages both list φ150, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ220, φ230 and φ250. Split-only sizes include φ260 and φ280. Integral-only sizes include φ160, φ205, φ210 and φ225. Materials are printed on the split page only.
description.zh: 分体活塞和整体活塞两页都有 φ150、φ180、φ195、φ200、φ220、φ230、φ250。只在分体页的有 φ260 和 φ280。只在整体页的有 φ160、φ205、φ210、φ225。材料只印在分体页。

h1.en: Split and integral pistons that share an outer diameter
h1.zh: 外径相同的分体活塞和整体活塞

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery publishes two piston pages. A shared outer diameter is two rows, not one part. Split pistons are sets and print a material. Integral pistons are pieces and do not print a material. Neither page names a pump model.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械公布了两张活塞页。外径相同是两行目录，不是一件配件。分体活塞按套，并印了材料。整体活塞按个，没有印材料。两页都没有点名泵型号。

heading.zh: 相同的尺寸和不同的尺寸

heading.en: What does not follow from a shared number
heading.zh: 同一个数字不能推出什么

body.en: A shared OD does not assign either piston to Electric 20, HBT8018 or any other published pump. Pipe cells in millimetres are not piston outer diameters. Service life is missing on both pages.
body.zh: 外径相同，也不会把任一种活塞指定给电动20、HBT8018 或其他已公布泵。以毫米写出的管子格子不是活塞外径。两页都缺少寿命。

body.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. The first word should be split or integral, then the outer diameter, then set or piece.
body.zh: 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 第一个词写分体或整体，然后写外径，再写套或个。

question.en: Does φ200 exist on both pages?

answer.en: Yes. On the split page the φ200 row is rubber, rubber-cloth and polyurethane, sold as a set. On the integral page φ200 is a piece and the material is not printed.
answer.zh: 有。分体页的 φ200 是橡胶、橡胶夹布和聚氨酯，按套。整体页的 φ200 按个，材料没有印。

answer.en: No. φ160 is on the integral list only.
answer.zh: 不是。φ160 只在整体活塞清单里。

answer.en: This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine.
answer.zh: 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。

answer.en: A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank.
answer.zh: 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。

label.en: Email or WhatsApp the Xingtai factory
label.zh: 邮件或 WhatsApp 联系邢台工厂
